details: Literal translation: `"Now don't you, keep you"`
Translation: `"Now don't hold back or keep anything from me"`

lines.line: **Mere Dil Ka Yeh Chota Mota Haq Maar Ke**
details: Word-by-word breakdown into English: `Mere` (My) | `Dil` (Heart) | `Ka` (Of) | `Yeh` (This) | `Chota Mota` (Small / Minor) | `Haq` (Right / Due) | `Maar Ke` (Usurping / Denying)
Literal translation: `"Killing/denying this small minor right of my heart"`
Translation: `"By denying my heart its small, rightful due"`
Literal translation: `"By mistake, made a mistake"`
Translation: `"I made a huge mistake by accident"`

lines.line: **Kabhi Pichhe Pichhe Aaya Tere Jhak Maar Ke**
details: Word-by-word breakdown into English: `Kabhi` (Ever / Once) | `Pichhe Pichhe` (Behind / Following) | `Aaya` (Came) | `Tere` (Yours / Behind you) | `Jhak Maar Ke` (Doing something foolishly / out of desperation / eating crow)
Literal translation: `"Ever came behind you after banging my head/acting foolishly"`
Translation: `"When I foolishly came chasing after you"`
